name: Object-Order Ray Casting with Min/Max Octrees
aliases: Object-Order Ray Casting with Min/Max Octrees (Mora et al.)
definition: A software object-order ray casting method for regular grids using orthogonal projection and pre-computed min/max octrees to skip empty regions.
summary: Object-Order Ray Casting with Min/Max Octrees is a software volume rendering technique that processes visible cells directly using pre-computed octrees to skip empty regions, distinguishing it from image-order methods.
